Name: Apex Mastery - RPG Progression and Skill Tree
Author: JavCombita
Description:
[center][size=6][b]APEX MASTERY[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Become a Legend of the Farm.[/i][/size]

[b][size=4]🌎 Languages / Idiomas[/size][/b]
[b]English:[/b] Native support.
[b]Español:[/b] Traducción completa incluida. ¡El mod detectará tu idioma automáticamente![/center]
[line]
[size=5][b]🌾 WHAT IS APEX MASTERY?[/b][/size]
Apex Mastery is a complete re-engineering of Stardew Valley's progression system. Inspired by classic RPGs, this mod adds an interactive [b]Skill Tree[/b] [b][size=3]NOW WITH 63 UNIQUE NODES[/size][/b], allowing you to specialize your farmer like never before.
Reached level 10 in everything? The game doesn't end there. Use the new [b]Prestige System[/b] to reset your skills, gain Mastery Points, and unlock game-breaking powers.

[size=5][b]✨ KEY FEATURES[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Massive Skill Tree:[/b] 63 Nodes across 5 branches (Farming, Mining, Combat, Fishing, Foraging) and 1 sub-branch (Farming-Foraging).[/*]
[*][b]Point System:[/b] Earn Profession Points by leveling up. You choose where to spend them.[/*]
[*][b]Prestige Mechanic:[/b] Hit the level cap? "Ascend" to reset your levels to 0 and keep your Mastery Points. PLUS, each Ascension rewards you with Permanent Profession Points that stack with every new prestige life (1st gives +1, 2nd gives +2, etc.), bypassing the natural level cap![/*]
[*][b]Visual Interface:[/b] A beautiful, custom-drawn menu with animated pipe connections, pan, and zoom.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-Language:[/b] Native English support and full [b]Spanish translation[/b] included (auto-detects your game language).[/*]
[*][b]Customizable:[/b] Full support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/*]
[*][b]Retroactive Progression:[/b] Safe to install on existing saves! The mod automatically calculates and grants points for levels you have already achieved.[/*]
[*][b]ASCENSION XP BOOST:[/b] Making Prestige is a hard decision, so why not make it sweeter? You gain a Permanent Experience Multiplier every time you Ascend!.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]📱 ANDROID & TOUCH SUPPORT[/b][/size]
This mod was built from the ground up with mobile players in mind:
[list]
[*][b]HUD Button:[/b] A configurable on-screen button (Star Icon) to open the menu without a keyboard.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Touch:[/b] "Tap once to view info, Tap twice to buy". No more accidental purchases![/*]
[*][b]Positioning:[/b] Move the button anywhere on the screen using the config menu.[/*]
[*][b]Visibility Modes:[/b] Configure the menu to hide future nodes to avoid spoilers, or show the full tree for planning.[/*]
[/list]

🎮 [b][size=5]GAMEPAD & STEAM DECK SUPPORT[/size][/b] 
Play from the comfort of your couch! Full controller integration is here:
[list]
[*][b]Controller Snapping:[/b] Navigate the skill tree effortlessly using the D-Pad or Left Joystick. The cursor will automatically snap to the nodes.[/*]
[*][b]Native Feel:[/b] Seamless integration with Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch controllers. Perfect for Steam Deck players![/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=5][b]📜 FULL SKILL LIST & EFFECTS 🔥[/b][/size]

Want to know exactly what you are unlocking? Click below to reveal the full tree.

[spoiler]
[b]🌾 FARMING (Agriculture & Animals)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Zen Watering:[/b] Watering can consumes 50% less energy.[/*]
[*][b]Seed Recovery:[/b] 10% chance to recover seeds upon harvest.[/*]
[*][b]Photosynthesis:[/b] Crops have a chance to grow faster overnight.[/*]
[*][b]Botanist:[/b] Crops sell for 20% more gold.[/*]
[*][b]Master Harvester:[/b] Harvest ANY crop using the Scythe (includes AOE harvesting).[/*]
[*][b]Animal Friend:[/b] Friendship with animals increases faster.[/*]
[*][b]Shepherd:[/b] Barn and Coop animals produce goods faster.[/*]
[*][b]Incubator:[/b] Incubation and pregnancy times are reduced by 30%.[/*]
[*][b]Artisan Quality:[/b] Animal products are always high quality (Gold/Iridium).[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Herder:[/b] Animal doors open automatically in valid weather.[/*]
[*][b]Gaia's Blessing (Mastery):[/b] Giant crops appear more often.[/*]
[*][b]Junimo Spirit (Mastery):[/b] Junimos work in rain and winter.[/*]
[*][b]Golden Touch (Mastery):[/b] EVERYTHING you sell is worth +50%.[/*]
[/list]

[b]⛏️ MINING (Ores & Explosives)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Strong Arm:[/b] Pickaxe consumes less energy.[/*]
[*][b]Spelunker:[/b] Ladders appear 15% more often.[/*]
[*][b]Rich Vein:[/b] Metal nodes drop extra ore.[/*]
[*][b]Geomancy:[/b] Higher chance to find geodes.[/*]
[*][b]Transmutation:[/b] Furnaces works 50% faster.[/*]
[*][b]Dangerous:[/b] Bombs have a larger explosion radius (+1).[/*]
[*][b]Pyrotechnic:[/b] Chance to refund materials when crafting bombs.[/*]
[*][b]Blast Shield:[/b] You are immune to damage from your own bombs.[/*]
[*][b]Carbon:[/b] Coal appears twice as often.[/*]
[*][b]Gemologist:[/b] Gems sell for 30% more gold.[/*]
[*][b]Dwarven Tech (Mastery):[/b] Bombs have a massive nuclear radius (+3).[/*]
[*][b]Crystal Master (Mastery):[/b] Crystalariums work 2x faster.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Soul (Mastery):[/b] Regular stones have a chance to drop Iridium Ore.[/*]
[/list]

[b]⚔️ COMBAT (Defense & Offense)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Vitality:[/b] Permanently gain +10 Max HP.[/*]
[*][b]Iron Skin:[/b] Gain a permanent Defense Buff.[/*]
[*][b]Tank:[/b] You are immune to the "Slimed" debuff.[/*]
[*][b]Regeneration:[/b] Slowly regenerate health over time.[/*]
[*][b]Immortal:[/b] Prevent death once per day (revive with 20 HP).[/*]
[*][b]Brute Force:[/b] Gain a permanent Attack Damage Buff.[/*]
[*][b]Lethal:[/b] +5% Critical Hit Chance.[/*]
[*][b]Swift Strike:[/b] Deal +10% extra damage (simulating attack speed).[/*]
[*][b]Assassin:[/b] Critical hits deal massive damage (x3).[/*]
[*][b]Vampirism:[/b] Recover Health when killing monsters.[/*]
[*][b]God of War (Mastery):[/b] Gain a massive Attack Buff (+50% Damage).[/*]
[*][b]Juggernaut (Mastery):[/b] Permanently gain +100 Max HP.[/*]
[*][b]Soul Eater (Mastery):[/b] Killing monsters restores Energy.[/*]
[/list]

[b]🎣 FISHING (Utility)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Efficient Bait:[/b] 50% chance to not consume bait.[/*]
[*][b]Stable Reel:[/b] Fishing bar decreases slower.[/*]
[*][b]Trapper:[/b] Crab Pots are cheaper to craft (refunds materials).[/*]
[*][b]Pirate:[/b] Chance to find treasure is doubled.[/*]
[*][b]Line Master:[/b] Legendary fish are significantly easier to catch.[/*]
[*][b]Poseidon (Mastery):[/b] Fish sell for 3x gold.[/*]
[*][b]Timeless Angler (Mastery):[/b] Catch any fish from any season/weather/time.[/*]
[*][b]Titanium Tackle (Mastery):[/b] Fishing tackles (bobbers) never break.[/*]
[/list]

[b]🌲 FORAGING (Gathering)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Eagle Eye:[/b] Forageable items are tracked on-screen with arrows.[/*]
[*][b]Lumberjack:[/b] Trees and stumps drop extra wood.[/*]
[*][b]Winged Boots:[/b] +10% Movement Speed.[/*]
[*][b]Tracker:[/b] Wild greens are Gold/Iridium quality.[/*]
[*][b]Symbiosis:[/b] Wild trees have a 50% chance to grow instantly overnight.[/*]
[*][b]Forest Spirit (Mastery):[/b] +2 Permanent Speed boost (stacks with boots).[/*]
[*][b]Wild Feast (Mastery):[/b] Eating forage items restores 300% Health/Energy.[/*]
[/list]

[b]🌾🌲 FARMING-FORAGING (Agriculture & Gathering)[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Pomologist:[/b] Wild Fruits are Gold/Iridium quality.[/*]
[*][b]Horticulturist:[/b] Wild Vegetables are Gold/Iridium quality.[/*]
[*][b]Florist:[/b] Wild Flowers are Gold/Iridium quality.[/*]
[*][b]Mycologist:[/b] Wild Mushrooms are Gold/Iridium quality.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[b]Compatibility:[/b] Works on Stardew Valley 1.6 (PC) and the latest SMAPI on Android.
[line]
[center][i]Developed with ❤️ by JavCombita[/i][/center]
